data.exact_reserve_text: Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the adjustments are made.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of $9.378 million, representing a 7.57% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development is part of the ongoing process of estimating claims liabilities, which involves actuarial techniques, past experience, and adjustments for factors like market conditions, economic conditions, and claims handling procedures. The ultimate liability can vary due to subsequent information and events.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure from Note 5 (Change in estimates of prior year provisions) is -9.378m (release). A cross-check using the gross claims development triangle (Note 23) for underwriting years 2022 and older yields a strengthening of +5.938m. The figure from Note 5 is used as it represents the aggregate adjustment to claims outstanding for prior years, which is typically more comprehensive than a simple diagonal comparison of the claims triangle.
